description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)获取当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

> Call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
要删除的IP黑名单。支持自定义IP或IP段黑名单，同时支持IPv4和IPv6。多个IP之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。
更多信息，请参见[重保场景防护](~~425591~~)。
description.en: The IP address blacklist to be deleted. Supports custom IP addresses or IP address segments in the blacklist, and supports both IPv4 and IPv6. Multiple IP addresses are separated by commas (,). For more information, see [Critical event protection](~~425591~~).

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region ID of the WAF instance. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: The Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: Outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.
The ID of the IP address blacklist rule for critical event protection.
The ID of the critical event protection template.

title.zh: 删除重保场景防护IP黑名单

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi delete-major-protection-black-ip --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 5332 --rule-id 20013135 --ip-list 192.0.XX.XX,192.0.XX.XX/24 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
